_comment: The card /config opens: a user's own chat models, and which one their conversations go
through. Sent as a finished interactive message, not a card-kit card — nothing streams into
it and there is nothing to stop.
This card is the way out of a model that does not work. Nothing on this path reaches an LLM,
so it answers whatever state the user's endpoint is in — which is the whole reason it is a
card and not something the agent does when asked.
A press replaces the whole form with the summary node: a card left standing is a card that
can be submitted again, hours later, against a configuration that has moved on — and the
token field would keep whatever was typed into it sitting in the chat history. The summary
never repeats the token, which is write-only everywhere else too.
A template rather than JSON built in code, so the wording and the layout can be changed
without a rebuild. The {} placeholders are label text, substituted by FeishuConfigForm; the
option lists and the selected index are set on the parsed tree instead, since a model name is
written by the user and must not be able to break the card.
Names must be unique across the whole card, start with a letter, hold only letters, digits
and underscores, and stay within 20 characters.
select_static carries no label of its own — unlike input, it has neither label nor
label_position, and sending one is rejected outright with a 200621 parse error rather than
ignored. Its caption is the markdown row above it instead.
Which is why effortLabel is normal_v2 rather than the notation the section captions use: it
stands in for an input's label and sits between two real ones, so it has to be the size they
are. activeLabel is a section caption above the whole selection and stays notation.
